subject: dsa
title: LRU Cache
summary: Order keys most-recent first to evict the least-recently-used.
problem: Build a cache of capacity 2 that evicts the least-recently-used key. Keep keys in a list ordered most-recent first. A get or put moves a key to the front, and a put at capacity evicts the back. The calls are put(1,1), put(2,2), get(1), put(3,3), get(2).

example.input: capacity 2; put(1,1), put(2,2), get(1), put(3,3), get(2)

steps.caption: Capacity-2 cache. Keep keys most-recent first and evict the least-recent from the back.
After put(1) then put(2) the list of keys is [2,1], with 2 most recent.
get(1) moves key 1 to the front, giving [1,2].
put(3) finds the cache full, so the least-recent key 2 is evicted, giving [3,1].
get(2) returns -1 because 2 was evicted. The answer is -1.
